steps.name: EPF i Grievance Management System (EPFiGMS)
steps.channel: Online portal EPFiGMS or registration number at 1800 118 005
steps.when_to_use: When you have complaints, queries or concerns related to your EPF accounts, such as issues concerning contributions towards EPF.

steps.name: Centralized Public Grievances Redress And Monitoring System (CPGRAMS)
steps.when_to_use: To lodge public grievances to public authorities in Central Ministries/Departments.

note: Ensure you keep your acknowledgement number handy for tracking the status of your grievance.
